tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search active Remoote remote jobs. Use role_title to match job titles and query for broad keyword search. Returns capped public results with canonical Remoote URLs and no raw employer apply URLs.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Fetch public details for one active Remoote job, including salary, location, skills, excerpts, and a Remoote job URL.

tools.name: get_salary_stats
tools.description: Return salary stats for active Remoote jobs matching supported filters when enough normalized compensation data exists.

tools.name: get_top_jobs
tools.description: Return a capped public list of currently popular Remoote remote jobs.

tools.name: create_apply_intent
tools.description: Create a user-confirmed Remoote apply redirect for an authenticated agent token. Requires the apply:intent scope and never returns raw employer apply URLs.

tools.name: create_alert
tools.description: Create a daily or weekly Remoote job alert for the authenticated user. Requires the alerts:write scope.
